# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.6

This prerelease hardens lifecycle crash consistency and stable-release promotion without changing the established V1 or V2 visual design.

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently unavailable.

## What changed

- Prepare suite and bar-switch transactions privately before atomic publication
- Persist journals, snapshots, staged payloads, namespace renames, configuration, and recovery cleanup in crash-safe order
- Reject malformed or symlinked recovery state before changing plugins, configuration, install state, or the running shell
- Serialize manual recovery with active lifecycle workers
- Restore the exact pre-install Omarchy layout on the first return to the stock bar
- Report unavailable runtime logs instead of treating them as clean
- Classify stable GitHub releases separately from prereleases with validated SemVer handling
- Correct current documentation to the authoritative 24-plugin suite count
- Suppress hidden official Audio and Network keyboard-panel windows before compatibility redirects can briefly expose stock Omarchy UI

## Compatibility and release limits

- The suite remains 24 native Omarchy plugins in one Quickshell process
- No V1/V2 colors, geometry, typography, icons, animations, or layout design changed
- Compatibility remains revision-bound to the installed Omarchy `12af188` baseline and forward snapshot `fd1034f`
- Physical mixed-scale multi-monitor, enterprise Wi-Fi, remaining device-backed Bluetooth, and clean-chroot package checks remain explicit external stable gates

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.1-beta.5...v0.1.1-beta.6`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.5...v0.1.1-beta.6)
